      Mission handover

      OPERATOR DECISION

      Each geolocated observer cue waits here with its image for your decision. Approving records the decision. For an aircraft with a live point-command link it also prefills that aircraft's command workflow, where nothing is sent until you review and send it; for any other aircraft it is decision only: the approved point is marked on the map for the safety pilot and no command path exists. Every decision is logged.

        Areas of interest

        ADVISORY

        Observer cues from across the fleet, for a human look. Each is placed on the ground from the reporting aircraft's own telemetry; when two aircraft report the same thing in the same place, the cue says so. Confirm or dismiss each; nothing is tasked. A confirmed cue can drop its point into the command workflow below; nothing is sent until that workflow is reviewed and sent.

          Reading the map

          Drag to pan · scroll or + / − to zoom · Select an aircraft to center it · Dashed markers show last-known positions, never a live fix. Click the coordinates in the bottom bar to change format.

          About this view

          Read-only unless a control link is started for an aircraft (the status bar says so). Pilot QGroundControl connections remain independent, and each safety pilot's RC is the override.

          Unknown or stale readings display —. Mission items use the aircraft’s zero-based sequence and do not indicate completion. Full mission routes are unavailable in this passive view.

          Pause stops extra video; telemetry continues. Closing this page stops both optional laptop copies. Video delays differ between aircraft.
